payload.posture: Read Luke 3:1–6 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states rulers and priests locate the moment before the word of God comes to John son of Zacharias and sends him through the Jordan region. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
